hypothesis: Reusing one ZSTD_CCtx for repeated level-19 pack compression materially reduces Zstd CPU cost while preserving byte-identical output.
interpretation: The reusable context preserved exact bytes but reduced measured Zstd CPU by only ~0.084%, far below the frozen 5% retirement boundary, while median wall time was slightly worse. Context allocation/reinitialization is not a material owner of Analytics level-19 creation cost. Do not spend further effort on simple CCtx reuse as a speed rescue for the L19 path unless materially new evidence changes the mechanism.
claim_boundary: Research-only execution-architecture negative; no format, admission, product, benchmark-win, or release credit.
